pretreatments.description: Alkaline pretreatment using NaOH (5 N), KOH, or Ca(OH)₂ solutions at pH ranging from 8 to 13, mixed for 1 hour (individual) or 20 minutes (combined).
Thermal pretreatment by heating sludge samples (50 ml) in an oil bath from 110 °C to 150 °C for 20 minutes.
Ultrasonication using a VCX-750 probe with a 20 kHz frequency and 750 W amplitude for 1, 5, 10, 15, or 20 minutes.

Hydrodynamic cavitation (HC) using an orifice plate with 27 holes of 1 mm diameter in a 20 mm pipe, generating cavitation at a pressure drop to vapor pressure, with reaction times of 1, 5, 10, 15, and 20 minutes.
